props.gloss_en: do not reverse [the mishna]; the baraita is all R' Yosei's and is elliptical, and teaches thus

(the mishna unreversed) R' Yosei holds causing extinguishing is forbidden

if [the reed] is tight, it is an interposition
[the ink is] moist
blood, ink, honey and milk: dry, they interpose; moist, they do not interpose
Rava bar Rav Sheila: this is the Rabbis' reason -- they hold it is forbidden to stand before the Name naked
where there is a reed [at hand], so too [R' Yosei agrees he wraps it]
